description: Adversarial verification for work that is expensive to get wrong.

plugins.name: chimera
plugins.description: Six fenced role subagents plus a 2-critic REFUTE panel. One strong maker, an anchor-checking critic plus an executing confirmer in fresh context, a fatal-only veto — every other refutation is recorded as an open finding on the digest — and one bounded repair lap. Runs in whatever repo you are already in.
